title: PersonaManifold: Revealing and Exploiting Curved Geometry in LLM Persona Representations
issueTitle: Metric scale changes the geodesic-to-Euclidean ratio on a flat line
plainExplanation: A straight one-dimensional point cloud can have a ratio above or below one because only the numerator uses the inverse-covariance metric. Comparing path and chord in the same constant metric removes this scale effect; interpreting spatially varying metrics still requires a separate curvature argument.
